name: Behavior
description: A behavior island: a source widget no kit component carries (slider, tabs, accordion, counter, toggle, filter, in-page dialog, anchor links), kept as the site's own markup and wired by the kit's one small vanilla module. The markup is a rich-text field the writer has run through its island pass (no style, script, form or overlay; no source data-cr-*; ids prefixed); the data-cr-* attributes on the root come from props only. No script, or a refused selector: the island stays as printed, every item in reading order. Only pages with an island load the module.

kind.description: What the module makes of the markup: disclosure (aria-expanded/aria-controls, details), tablist (role=tab, arrow keys), carousel (a scroll-snap track over the items, previous/next), dialog (an opener and its panel as a modal), countup (numbers count up once in view), toggle (aria-pressed shows/hides), filter (data-filter buttons over the items), anchor (in-page links scroll). lightbox (a link to an image file opens the image in a modal).

html.label: Content
html.description: The widget's markup as the source rendered it, after the writer's island pass. Editable in Studio as HTML.

items.description: The engine's selector for the items inside the island (slides, counters, filtered cards).

title.description: A tablist's tab selector, when the source's tabs are not role=tab.

panel.description: A tablist's panel selector, in tab order, when the tabs do not name their panels.

fact.description: The source behavior's fact id; the gates find the island by it (data-cr-fact).

closeLabel.description: Dialog and lightbox close button (ui-strings dialog.close).

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.
